claims.text: The same record gives the full imprint: title 'Alien rapture', subtitle 'the chosen'; names 'Fouche, Edgar Rothschild, 1948-' (usage primary) and 'Steiger, Brad.'; place 'Lakeville, Minn'; agent 'Galde Press'; dateIssued 1998; edition '1st ed.'; extent 'xii, 275 p. ; 23 cm.'; ISBN 1880090503 and 9781880090503. Its recordContentSource is DLC and its recordCreationDate is 980204, that is 4 February 1998, which precedes both the book's publication and the August 1998 presentation.

claims.text: THE CATALOGUING, AND IT IS THE POINT OF THIS NODE. Library of Congress record LCCN 98002961 carries, under the gsafd genre authority, the genre element 'Science fiction.' Its Library of Congress subject heading is 'Alien abduction - Fiction'. Its LC classification is PS3556.O779 A79 1998, American literature, individual authors, 1961 onward, and its Dewey 21 classification is 813/.54, American fiction. The Library of Congress catalogues Alien Rapture: The Chosen as a novel.
